# api.mikeodnis.dev — Full Technical & LLM Reference

## Architecture Overview

`api.mikeodnis.dev` is the unified API gateway for the `*.mikeodnis.dev` platform by Mike Odnis.
Traffic enters through a Caddy reverse proxy (`services/gateway`) enforcing security headers, zstd/gzip compression, fail-closed upstream routing, and private-mesh IP forwarding to four internal services:

1. **Core Service (`/v1/core/*`)** — TypeScript, Bun, ElysiaJS, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis.
2. **Media Service (`/v1/media/*`)** — Go 1.26, Chi, hexagonal architecture, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2.
3. **Links GraphQL (`/v1/links/graphql`, `/v1/links/v1/graphql`)** — Hasura GraphQL Engine (allow-listed, admin endpoints blocked at gateway).
4. **Health Aggregator (`/health`)** — Consolidated service health monitor with 2-second coalesced probe caching.

## Authentication

### 1. HS256 JWT Bearer Tokens
Issued by `POST /v1/core/auth/login` or `POST /v1/core/auth/register`:
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
- Default access TTL: 15 minutes (`exp` claim required); rotating refresh tokens valid up to 30 days via `POST /v1/core/auth/refresh`.
- Includes `https://hasura.io/jwt/claims` (`x-hasura-user-id`, `x-hasura-default-role`, `x-hasura-allowed-roles`) for seamless GraphQL + Media service authentication.

### 2. Scoped API Keys (`mk_live_*`)
Created via `POST /v1/core/auth/api-keys` (Bearer JWT required) with up to 4 unique scopes (`read`, `write`, `media`, `links`):
- Header: `X-API-Key: mk_live_...` (or `Authorization: Bearer mk_live_...`)
- Keys are SHA-256 hashed at rest; the raw key is returned once on creation.
- Scoped API keys require the `read` scope for `GET /v1/core/auth/me` and `GET /v1/core/users/{id}`, and cannot manage API keys, mutate/delete accounts, or access admin routes (Bearer JWT required).

## Endpoints

### Core API (`/v1/core`)
- `GET /v1/core/health` — Liveness probe
- `GET /v1/core/health/ready` — PostgreSQL readiness probe (2s coalesced cache)
- `GET /v1/core/status` — Runtime uptime, memory RSS, and distributed Redis rate-limiter telemetry (`no-store`)
- `GET /v1/core/version`, `GET /v1/core/info` — Build metadata and companion URLs
- `GET /v1/core/openapi.json`, `GET /v1/core/docs` — OpenAPI 3.1 schema and Scalar UI
- `POST /v1/core/auth/register` — Create account (`email`, `name`, `password` >= 10 chars)
- `POST /v1/core/auth/login` — Sign in -> `{ user, access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in }`
- `POST /v1/core/auth/refresh` — Atomic single-use refresh token rotation
- `POST /v1/core/auth/logout` — Revoke refresh token
- `GET /v1/core/auth/me` — Authenticated user profile (JWT or `read`-scoped API key)
- `POST /v1/core/auth/api-keys`, `GET /v1/core/auth/api-keys`, `DELETE /v1/core/auth/api-keys/{id}` (Bearer JWT required)
- `GET /v1/core/users` (admin JWT), `GET /v1/core/users/{id}` (self/admin JWT or self `read` API key), `PATCH /v1/core/users/{id}` (JWT), `DELETE /v1/core/users/{id}` (JWT)

### Media API (`/v1/media`)
- `GET /v1/media/health`, `GET /v1/media/health/ready` (2s coalesced cache), `GET /v1/media/openapi.json`
- `POST /v1/media/upload` — Multipart upload (`file`, `visibility=public|private`), max 100 MiB (SVG 2 MiB), magic-byte + SVG active-content verified -> returns `{ id, filename, key, url, visibility, size, mime_type, etag, sha256, created_at }`
- `POST /v1/media/presign` — Generate direct-to-R2 presigned PUT URL targeting non-servable `staging/*` prefix (`{ filename, content_type, visibility }`)
- `POST /v1/media/assets/confirm` — Verify ETag-pinned staged object and atomically promote to live prefix (`{ key, filename, metadata }`)
- `GET /v1/media/assets?limit=50&offset=0` — Paginated list of authenticated user's assets (`offset <= 10000`)
- `GET /v1/media/assets/{id}`, `DELETE /v1/media/assets/{id}`
- `POST /v1/media/sign` — Mint HMAC-SHA256 signed URL for `cdn.mikeodnis.dev/private/*` (`{ asset_id | key, expires_in }`)
- `POST /v1/media/purge` — Purge Cloudflare edge cache for asset URLs (`{ files: [...] }`)

## Rate Limiting (IETF Draft Headers)

All rate-limited responses emit `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, `RateLimit-Policy`, and `Retry-After` on `429 Too Many Requests`.

| Service | Tier | Limit | Keying |
|---|---|---|---|
| Core | `auth` (login/register/refresh/logout) | 10 req / 60s | Trusted Client IP |
| Core | `auth-keys` (API key management) | 20 req / 60s | Verified JWT User / Trusted Client IP |
| Core | `write` (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) | 30 req / 60s | Verified JWT User / Dual IP + API key / IP |
| Core | `read` (GET/HEAD) | 100 req / 60s | Verified JWT User / Dual IP + API key / IP |
| Media | `media-ip` (outer ceiling) | 120 req / 60s | Trusted Client IP |
| Media | `media-write` (upload/presign/confirm/purge/delete) | 20 req / 60s | Authenticated User ID |
| Media | `media-read` (list/get/sign) | 100 req / 60s | Authenticated User ID |

## Working Examples

```bash
# 1. Inspect live gateway & Redis rate-limiter health
curl -sS https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/status

# 2. Authenticate and capture Bearer JWT
JWT=$(curl -sS -X POST https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"you@mikeodnis.dev","password":"your-password"}' | jq -r .access_token)

# 3. Upload a file to Cloudflare R2 and receive its cdn.mikeodnis.dev URL
curl -sS -X POST https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/media/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" \
  -F "file=@./image.png" \
  -F "visibility=public"
```
